subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add owner/human handoff for DM auto-reply, and should the first supported scope be WhatsApp-only or a shared channel contract covering Telegram and Discord too?
rationale: The issue asks for new channel config and pause/resume state that affects message delivery behavior, so code can’t safely choose the permanent product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: WhatsApp plugin-owned first
options.body: Add the handoff behavior only to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with room to generalize after live proof and user feedback.

options.title: Shared channel contract
options.body: Design a common channel handoff API and implement WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord together, accepting the larger compatibility and review surface.

options.title: No product feature for now
options.body: Keep current prompt/manual-pause workarounds and close or defer handoff automation until stronger live evidence or maintainer sponsorship exists.

recommendation.title: WhatsApp plugin-owned first
recommendation.body: Add the handoff behavior only to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with room to generalize after live proof and user feedback.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/API direction choice across channel config and plugin boundaries, where recent broad channel/plugin config work makes steipete the best available routing owner from the sampled history.
